summary: Iteration 11: tested the lag fix (FPS), the six 3D games, sound/mute, gating of the floating bars, and the backend fixes. FPS over 3s (headless, no GPU, 390px mobile): /home 60, /wallet 59, /profile 60, /admin 60 (desktop). Games: stopwatch 60 (before start), aviator 44, tower 50, vortex 37, chicken 26, stack 59. No page errors on any page. Backend: 36/37 pass. Updated test_vortex_chicken_stack.py for the phase/jitter engine (18/18 pass), test_aviator_tower.py 9/9 pass, new test_iter11_fixes.py 9/10 pass. Verified: forfeit of active vortex and chicken rounds (status 'forfeited', game recorded with details.forfeited, seed revealed in /fair/rounds, old token gives 409); /games/vortex/active and /chicken/active (resumable session, then {active:false}); vortex 'won' only if total > bet (partial collect then loss is 'lost'); admin null/'garbage'/'NaN' gives 400 with config unchanged; chicken hazard 5.0 clamped to 0.9 and restored; versus heights hidden while LIVE until I submit (bot submitted but no height shown), visible after COMPLETED; /play after the deadline gives 409; /finish into a COMPLETED room is ignored (height stays 0); the bot_like flag works on a machine-precision run (10 perfects gives flagged, payout 0); human-like runs (8-12ms noise) are not flagged. FAIL: PUT /admin/config with vortex_config.themes = {earth: 'garbage'} returns 500 (AttributeError 'str' object has no attribute 'get' in sanitize_extra_config). Frontend: Stopwatch 3D readout updates live (0.19, 0.71 ... 4.61) and the value after STOP (5.01) matches result-time 5.01. Aviator: canvas OK, multiplier rises, manual cash-out at 1.31x (+26), crash shows FLEW AWAY, history updates, auto cash-out at 1.20x works. Tower: tiles tower-tile-{row}-{col} move up row by row, gems shown, cash-out 45.00, bombs revealed, win popup. Vortex: themes switch, wheel canvas, a loss ('Vortex broke'), partial 14.40 (button then disabled), spin, collect, wallet math matches. Chicken: lane counts easy 24 / medium 22 / hard 20 / hardcore 15, GO x3, collect at lane 3, result shown. Stack: in-page timed taps gave height 11 with 8 perfects, UI 1.12x = 22.40, matching the server; a random first tap toppled at 0 (by design). Mute: toggles aria-label Mute/Unmute, localStorage tu_muted 1/0, persists across games. quick-actions and win-ticker are absent on all /games/* pages and present on /home, /wallet and /profile.

minor.issue: A nested non-dict value (vortex_config.themes.earth = 'garbage', or a chicken_config.modes entry that is a string) gives 500 AttributeError in sanitize_extra_config (t.get / m.get on a str). Also nested null values (themes.lose items, modes.hazard/steps = null) are silently replaced with defaults instead of returning 400, which is inconsistent with the top-level rule.

The anti-bot is easy to bypass. phases and jitter are sent to the client, so a script that computes the perfect time and adds ±8-12ms random noise gets 100% perfects, is not flagged, and wins every timed/versus room (proven in pytest with 30/30 perfects in versus, and in the UI). This is acceptable for an MVP but not real protection: consider a server-side input cadence or variance check, reaction-time statistics, or not revealing future phases.
There is no deadline check in finish itself. A run finished after the deadline but before the 3s tick flips the room to SETTLING is still accepted (_mp_submit only checks status LIVE).

integration_issues.issue: The new GET /games/vortex/active and /games/chicken/active are never called by the frontend (grep finds no '/active' in src). If a user leaves mid-round and comes back, they can't resume. The next Start silently forfeits the round, losing the bet and the at-risk amount without warning.

issues: On the result screen, faded 'Play again (20) & Win 100' and loss-replay text are visible through the stopwatch dial above the result card (layered or semi-transparent). This may be a transition captured mid-animation; please verify.
The page auto-scrolls so the sticky header hides the top part of the 3D canvas (the chicken sits at the very top edge of the visible road).
The header content (logo and Sign out) is narrower and offset from the body container, so the left and right edges don't line up.

action_items: Fix the 500 in sanitize_extra_config for nested non-dict values: check isinstance(t, dict) / isinstance(m, dict), add bad entries to `bad`, and return 400 for null or garbage nested numbers (themes.lose, modes.hazard/steps).
Wire the /games/vortex/active and /games/chicken/active endpoints into VortexSpin.js and ChickenQuest.js on mount to resume a round, or at least warn before Start forfeits an active round.
Optional: harden the Tower Stack anti-bot (noise-added perfect scripts pass) and reject a versus /finish after the deadline in stack_finish.
Check the faded overlay text on the Stopwatch result screen.
critical_code_review_comments: games_extra.py is 999 lines, above the 700-line limit; split it into vortex.py, chicken.py, stack.py and fair.py.
sanitize_extra_config: int(vc.get('segments', 12) or 12) runs after fix() so it is OK, but nested loops assume dicts (this causes the 500).
_forfeit_active for vortex records won = total > entry_fee, which is consistent with the new rule; it credits nothing extra (the partial was already credited), which is correct.
The perf CSS at the end of index.css uses !important to globally remove backdrop-filter and animations on .pz-scifi. It works (60fps), but the older body.pz-gaming rules are now redundant.
seed_data_creation: None. The player balance was set to 10000 by the test fixtures. Admin config was restored after the tests (chicken hardcore hazard 0.4, all 3 games enabled, vortex themes intact).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the pytest files with -n 0 (pytest.ini enables xdist, and parallel workers interfere through the shared balance and forfeits). The perfect_taps(eng, n, noise) helper in test_vortex_chicken_stack.py is phase/jitter aware; noise=True gives human-like runs. Versus tests speed up LIVE by backdating players.0.joined_at and bot_finish_at/deadline in Mongo. test_garbage_nested_theme is expected to fail until sanitize is fixed. 1v1/Multiplayer rooms using the 3D Stopwatch were NOT tested this iteration.
rca of the issue: Admin config 500: in sanitize_extra_config, `for t in (vc.get('themes') or {}).values(): t.get('lose')` raises AttributeError when a theme value is not a dict; the same applies to chicken modes `m.get`. Repro: PUT /api/admin/config {data:{vortex_config:{...valid, themes:{earth:'garbage'}}}} returns 500. Fix: skip or flag non-dict entries and return 400.
